newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel sees support at 129.92.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel sees support at 129.92.

text.p: French bond futures traded on MATIF are pinned down by the ailing Bund contract, but the extent of notionnel's decline is likely to be smaller, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
"There is a good area of support around 129.92/88," said David Wood, independent technical analyst near London.
Daily charts show September notionnel futures reached a high of 129.88 on July 2, and a high of 129.92 on July 4.
September notionnel futures dropped 36 basis points from Friday's close to 130.22 at 0800 GMT. MATIF was closed on Monday for a market holiday.
The contract was due for a reversal, Wood said.
"We had reached almost to the major peak at 131.24." Notionnel futures reached a high of 131.24 on daily continuation charts on June 16.
"It's getting held down by the Bund, but it's not quite as dramatic as the Bund," Wood added.
Hans-Guenter Redeker, technical analyst at Chase, found Elliott wave support at 130.17.
"The medium term trend remains intact as long as it trades above 130.17 and from here it should move impulsively higher," he said in a note.
Immediate resistance is at Friday's low of 130.38, Wood said. The contract gapped down at Tuesday's open to 130.32, the session high so far.
"The contract looks soft below the 130.38-130.50 area," he added.
Redeker also favoured 130.38 as major resistance.
"In order to maintain short-term upside momentum it is essential that 130.38 holds," he said.
September PIBOR futures traded at 96.50 at 0815 GMT, down 0.05 from Friday's close.
